correctness.rationale: In the standard symmetric model, in characteristic at least seven the nodes have three plus and three minus coordinates (the six squares agree and the coordinate sum vanishes). The planes set matched coordinate pairs to be negatives of one another. Thus a node lies on a plane exactly when all matched pairs cross its triple partition. There are six matchings per node, four compatible nodes per plane, and two matchings shared by any distinct nodes. This gives II^t=4Id+2J and the stated connected Laplacian spectrum; the tree count is 2^29*5^8. The coordinate S6 is the split automorphism group and the twists realize every conjugacy class: any such permutation is the image of a continuous cocycle from the procyclic Galois group for the constant automorphism group. Independently generating the incidence and all eleven permutations, I took partial sums to express the Laplacian columns and permutation differences in the integral basis e_i-e_(i+1), and computed exact column Hermite then Smith forms. All eleven rows (and their orders) match, including C4+C8+C80 for a six-cycle and C2^3+C20 for (3,2,1). The perfect equivariant monodromy pairing identifies the dual of the coinvariants with the fixed group; it implies the same abstract invariant factors, not a canonical fixed-to-coinvariant isomorphism. Finite étale descent of the finite abstract group with its Galois action gives precisely this fixed group on k-points.
residual_risks: Analysis is for the specified characteristics and graph Jacobian, not a threefold's algebraic class or cohomology group.
